options.description: A red line in the band: 'plumb is older than main (built <date>): reload plugins'. It stays until the session runs the current build. Nothing reinstalls behind your back.
options.label: Red warning + the fix (Recommended)

options.description: The same red line, and plumb also refreshes Claude Code's installed copy itself, so the next reload or session picks it up. Faster, but it changes your install without asking.
options.label: Red warning + auto-update

options.description: Plumb refuses to judge or land anything while it runs an older build, until you reload. Safest against stale behaviour, but it stops work.
options.label: Block plumb's checks

payload.question: When the plumb Claude Code is running is older than main's, what should happen?
